Restore now closes the folded menu first (`useStudioFoldedMenuClose`), so no hidden menu stays open behind the dialog. Both bugs were found live and pinned, and each pin goes red under ablation.

The seat read this card's own four commits (`10d0e0a3`, `2aac8138`, `5de32e80`, `25aaa060`): each carries only the model-free trailer pair, with no card number. The squash message is the PR body.
